messages:
alex: hey all — first week checklist Q: who do I ping for the different ownership lanes? e.g., infra creds, model onboarding, API routes, and oncall shadowing. don't want to ping the wrong folks :grimacing:
emma (people-ops): welcome! :tada: short answer: infra creds -> #eng-infra + @matt, model onboarding -> eng-ml + @leo, API routes/owner questions -> eng-platform, oncall shadowing -> eng-oncall/eng-sre depending on the service. i'll DM a quick list for you.
matt (eng-platform): +1. for API route ownership we keep the OWNERS files in the repo (root/OWNERS and services/*/OWNERS). if you tell me the repo or service name i can point you to the person. also for service-level deploys ping #release-war-room (or the deploy-bot for status).
sara (eng-sre): oncall shadowing — we usually pair for 2 days with the oncall for a given service. DM me which service you'll be working on and i'll schedule a short overlap with the SRE oncall. in emergencies use @here in #incidents only if pager escalates.
leo (eng-runtime): model onboarding: we have a gated checklist in the docs (https://internal/docs/model-onboard). short items: data privacy checklist, perf profile, and quantization recommendations. ping eng-ml or me for the perf profile. if you need a model variant test slot, include the workload and expected qps and we'll book dedicated capacity.
alex: thanks! can you paste the access request template? i have a couple of repos and need db read / infra infra creds.
emma (people-ops): sure — use this template and post in #access-requests (or DM me if blocked):
```
Subject: Access request — alex — team: eng-platform
Resources: repo(s) name(s), infra project id(s), monitoring dashboards
Access needed: (read/write/admin)
Justification: (brief)
Duration: (permanent/temp until DD/MM)
Approver: (team owner)
```
we triage access requests weekdays 9–5 PT. expect ~1 business day for standard repo access, 2–3 business days for infra roles.
matt (eng-platform): for repo OWNERS, run `git ls-files | grep OWNERS` or check the repo root. if it's a service owned by runtime, owners are usually `team-runtime@redwood`. if you need a direct contact: @matt or @leo.
sara (eng-sre): escalation paths: page -> primary oncall -> secondary -> eng-sre rotation -> eng-platform rotation. if page at night and no response, escalate to @sara or the #eng-sre channel. we've got runbook links in the incident channel pinned.
alex: any recommendations on who to shadow for infra vs runtime? want a compact schedule for week 1.
leo (eng-runtime): suggestion: Mon AM — pairing with @matt (platform) to walk through API routes + OWNERS, Mon PM — access requests + infra onboarding with @emma, Tue/Wed — shadow runtime model onboarding with me (perf tests), Thu — SRE shadowing for oncall basics with @sara, Fri — sync + 30min Q&A with your manager and the owners we connected.
emma (people-ops): i can set up the calendar invites and add the access request as a pre-req. alex — do you prefer calendar invites or google doc agenda?
alex: calendar invites please, with links to docs. that would be awesome.
deploy-bot: deploy status: last deploy for service-x succeeded at 2026-03-22T09:05:23Z :white_check_mark: (no blockers)
matt (eng-platform): FYI: if you hit terraform plan issues, add `TF_LOG=trace` to the command and paste logs here. don't share secrets.
alex: got it, thanks everyone — super helpful. i'll post the access request in #access-requests now and follow up after the shadow sessions. :wave:
